description: Liñas Eléctricas is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Liñas Eléctricas, elaborated from available Xeographic Databases not IET, from the Topographical Base of Galicia do Instituto de Estudos do Territorio da Consellería de Medio Ambiente e Ordenación do Territorio and from the National Topographical Base of Instituto Geográfico Nacional do Ministerio de Fomento. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Liñas Electric" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2015-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
